source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.5.1.2 (PDF 146, printed 143).

blocks.text: Line graphs waqt ke saath trends (barhna ya ghatna) dikhate hain. Yeh data points laga kar unhein line se jorte hain, jis se change (tabdeeli) aasani se nazar aata hai.

Misal: Agar aap hafte bhar ka temperature likhein to line graph dikhayega ke har din temperature kaise charhta aur girta hai. (Kitab ki Figure 5.5 ek hi din ke 10 am se 8 pm tak ke temperature dikhati hai.)

blocks.alt: Line graph, title Temperature, degree C, subah 10 baje se raat 8 baje tak: 10 am par -5, 12 pm par 1, 2 pm par 2, 4 pm par -3, 6 pm par -5 aur 8 pm par -9; scale -10 se 4 tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Waqt ke saath temperature ka change dikhane wala line graph (kitab ki Figure 5.5 jaisa hamara apna diagram).

blocks.prompt: Paanch din ki stall ki kamai dikhane ke liye line graph behtar hai ya bar chart?
blocks.explanation: Line graph, kyun ke din waqt ke saath ek ke baad ek aate hain aur line 500 se 1,300 rupay tak barhta trend dikhati hai.

items: Line graph: waqt ke saath trend.
